title: I don't like nether
description: Don't like the Nether? Normally, with this mod, you'll be able to get Nederite without going to the Nether by processing gravel. I'll be doing the same with upgrade templates soon.
body:
# I don't like nether.

****_A newly released mod that makes it so you don't have to die over and over again in the nether, making it easier to mine netherite. Since it's recently released, there are no recipes for the blacksmithing upgrades yet, but that's coming next._** Dont work whit ~~optifine~~ and only work whit forge.**


# **Recipes and Stages:**

**1. Cook in a furnace, gravel to get Scrap Grave.**

**2. Put 9 scrap gravel in the crafting table and you will get melted gravel.**
   
**3. Put melted grave on all sides except the center and a lava cube in the center and you will 
get netherite scrap.**

**4. Do it 4 times and you will have enough to get 1 netherite ingot gg congratulations.**
 
**Don't use ~~optifine~~**
